snippet.title: High Lance | Launch Trailer | Out now on Steam
snippet.description:
Tap to flap. Higher lance wins.

Ride a griffin over an endless world of floating ledges. Unseat rival riders by meeting them with your lance held higher, then catch them as they parachute down before a griffin carries them back into the fight. Three ranks of riders, surges from the liquid below, and five lands, each ending with a dragon.

One button is all it takes. Full controller support, Steam Deck ready.

Out now on Steam for Windows, macOS and Linux:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5460740/High_Lance/

Everything you see and hear is our own work: the art, the sounds and the music.

High Lance © 2026 Aviary Interactive
